Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1287622. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Filter by target ChEMBL ID, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and non-null pChEMBL value. Return the first 1000 rows ordered by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Do not deduplicate rows.
